verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a local development runner (pipecat.runner.run) and Pipecat Evals, but neither is documented as a sandbox environment that isolates tests from production data. Evals explicitly runs against "your real agent (the same pipeline, the same services, the same code)", and local inference via ollama is a user-side arrangement. These are adjacent features, not a sandboxed test environment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
